fills: the prompts after Example Component Prompts in the Agent Prompt Guide
formula: each prompt starts 'Create a <component or section>:'
then fills and text as var(--…) pairs, type roles, radius and padding as var(--…), and contents
a section prompt takes its fill and text from that section's row in sectionGrounds and names the element that dominates it
rules: var(--…) names only for colors, radius and spacing
at least one prompt per supplied prompt input
at least one prompt names an occasion component exactly
at least one prompt builds a whole section on a tint or accent ground from sectionGrounds
a lead fact takes the supplied fact role, as its component paragraph has it

prompts: Create a Kiln slot card: var(--immersive-palette-50) fill with var(--immersive-on-palette-50) text, var(--borderRadius-400) corners, var(--space-3) padding, the slot time in title3 and one main action on var(--immersive-action) with a var(--immersive-on-action) label.
